text_en: You have the right to be treated with respect and dignity.
text_pcm: You get right make dem treat you with respect.

text_en: You have the right to quality care, and to urgent attention when you need it.
text_pcm: You get right to better care, and make dem attend to you quick when you need am.

text_en: You have the right to complain and to be heard.
text_pcm: You get right to complain, and make dem hear you.
